# agterm

> Native macOS terminal on libghostty with a deliberately small interface and a full control API

agterm is a native macOS terminal, built on libghostty (Ghostty's engine), with a deliberately small interface and a full control API. Instead of scattering sessions across tabs, it groups them into named workspaces, and almost everything that structure holds is also an object a script can address: the bundled agtermctl creates and types into sessions, runs overlays, moves windows, sets a session's status glyph, and reads that state back over a local socket. Running many AI coding agents at once is the obvious use, and far from the only one. With nothing scripted it is a fast, modern general-purpose terminal for everyday work.

## Key Features

- Two-level vertical sidebar: workspaces grouping their sessions, with drag-reorder, a flagged working-set view, and single-workspace focus
- Agent-status glyphs on sidebar rows: active, blocked, completed, idle — auto-wired for Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and OpenCode
- agtermctl control CLI over a local unix-domain socket: create, rename, move, and type into sessions, run overlays, move windows, capture output, post notifications tied to a session
- Installable agent skill that teaches Claude Code and Codex the control model and the full agtermctl command set
- Surfaces per session: split panes (two shells), a per-session scratch terminal, and floating/full overlays; plus one app-wide quick terminal in a floating panel, summonable by a system-wide hotkey
- Multi-window: a library of windows (e.g. "work" and "personal"), one per screen, restored on next launch
- 512 bundled themes with a live-preview picker, fully rebindable kitty-flavored keymap.conf, and full session persistence
- In-terminal search, fuzzy command palettes, and a Ctrl-Tab MRU session switcher

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://agterm.com/docs): full reference — install, keybindings, keymap.conf, ghostty config, themes, control API
- [Control API commands](https://agterm.com/commands): the complete agtermctl command catalog
- [README](https://github.com/umputun/agterm/blob/master/README.md): the project synopsis, with install, the model, and the control-API demo
- [Architecture](https://github.com/umputun/agterm/blob/master/ARCHITECTURE.md): module split, surface ownership, and the libghostty C boundary

## Install

- [Releases](https://github.com/umputun/agterm/releases): signed and notarized DMG downloads (Apple Silicon, macOS 14+)
- [Homebrew cask](https://github.com/umputun/homebrew-apps): `brew install --cask umputun/apps/agterm`
